faq.description: Common questions about working with me.

q1.question: How does the onboarding process work?
q1.answer: We start with a discovery call to understand your goals, followed by a detailed proposal with timeline and milestones. Once approved, we kick off with a strategy session.

q2.question: How fast will I receive my deliverables?
q2.answer: Timelines depend on scope. A landing page takes 1-2 weeks, while a full SaaS platform takes 6-12 weeks. I always provide realistic timelines upfront.

q3.question: What technologies do you use?
q3.answer: I work with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and various AI/ML frameworks. I choose the best stack for each project's specific needs.

q4.question: Do you work with international clients?
q4.answer: Absolutely. I work with clients worldwide and am comfortable across time zones. Communication happens via Slack, email, or your preferred channel.

q5.question: What if I need changes after the project is done?
q5.answer: Every project includes a set number of revisions. After that, I offer ongoing support and maintenance packages at competitive rates.

q6.question: Can you build AI-powered features?
q6.answer: Yes. I have experience with machine learning, NLP, computer vision, and integrating AI APIs like OpenAI into production applications.
